ائتنست (form VIII)
# اِئْتَنَسْتُ (iʔtanastu) /iʔ.ta.nas.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
# اِئْتَنَسْتَ (iʔtanasta) /iʔ.ta.nas.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
# اِئْتَنَسْتِ (iʔtanasti) /iʔ.ta.nas.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
# اِئْتَنَسَتْ (iʔtanasat) /iʔ.ta.na.sat/: third-perso
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
